question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CAST(bs.runs_scored AS INTEGER)), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player_id,
        pr.total_runs,
        pm.matches_played,
        CASE WHEN pm.matches_played > 0 THEN pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
),
player_country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(par.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_avg_runs par
    JOIN player p ON par.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
SELECT * FROM player_country_avg ORDER BY country_avg_runs_per_match DESC LIMIT 5
